newsitem.title: THAILAND: TABLE-Thai July wholesale prices up 0.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Thai July wholesale prices up 0.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The Thai wholesale price index (WPI) rose 0.6 percent year-on-year in July against a 1.4 percent decline in the previous month, the Commerce Ministry said on Friday.
The ministry said wholesale prices rose 1.0 percent in July from June against a 1.2 percent month-on-month fall in the previous month.
The ministry said the 1985-based index rose to 156.0 in July from its 155.0 level in July 1996.
